title: सङ्गीतमा नादानुसन्धान
nepali: नादलाई साक्षात् ब्रह्मस्वरूप मानेको हुनाले सम्पूर्ण जगत नै नादको अधीनमा रहेको मानिन्छ । यहि नादको साधना वा माध्यमले ब्रह्म प्राप्ति अथवा अभिष्ट लक्ष्यको साक्षात्कार गर्नको लागि गरिने खोजलाई नादानुसन्धान भनिएको छ । सङ्गीतमा प्रयोग हुने ध्वनिलाई पनि नाद भनिएको छ । त्यसैले सङ्गीत सृजनाको आधार पनि नाद नै रहेको मान्न सकिन्छ । आहत र अनाहत गरी २ नादमा ब्रह्म साक्षात्कार गराउने नाद र लौकिक ख्याति प्राप्ति गराउने नादको उत्पत्ति, भेद, स्वरूप, लक्षण र महत्व लगायतका विषयमा स्पष्टता हासिल गर्नु नै यस अध्ययनको उद्देश्य रहेको छ । यसका लागि सङ्गीत एवं वैदिक वाङ्मयमा दिइएका तथ्य र प्रमाणहरूका आधारमा गुणात्मक विधिद्वारा व्याख्या तथा विश्लेषण गरी सुक्ष्मताले नियाल्ने र त्यसलाई उजागर गर्ने लक्ष्य राखिएको छ । ब्रह्म प्राप्ति अथवा मोक्षमार्गमा जान चाहनेले आहतको तुलनामा अनाहत नादको उपासना धेरै गर्ने गरेको र यसलाई मुक्तिदायक नाद मानेको पाइयो भने संसारको विलासिता र अनेक लौकिक इच्छा पूर्तिको कामना गर्नेहरूले केवल आहत नाद अर्थात् रक्तिदायक नादको साधना गर्ने गरेको पाइएको छ । साथै अनाहत नादको व्यवहारिक सङ्गीतसंग कुनै सम्वन्ध नरहेको भनिए तापनि अत्यन्त चञ्चल मन उपास्यब्रह्ममा स्थिर गर्न आहतनादले पनि ठुलो भूमिका निर्वहन गरेको हुन्छ भन्ने अध्ययनले देखाएको छ । नादानुसन्धानको विषयमा अध्ययन गर्न चाहनेहरूलाई यस अध्ययनको परिणामले ज्ञान अभिबृद्धि गर्नुको साथै शास्त्र प्रमाणित निश्चित मार्ग प्रशस्त गर्ने छ भन्ने अपेक्षा गरिएको छ ।
american_english: Because nada (primordial sound) is regarded as the very form of Brahman, the entire universe is believed to be under the dominion of nada. The quest undertaken to realize Brahman or to directly experience a desired goal through the practice or medium of this nada is called nadanusandhana. The sound used in music is also called nada. Therefore, it can be considered that nada is also the basis of musical creation. The objective of this study is to gain clarity on subjects including the origin, types, nature, characteristics, and significance of the nada that brings about the realization of Brahman and the nada that brings worldly fame, among the two kinds of nada, ahata and anahata. For this, with the aim of closely examining and bringing to light explanations and analyses through a qualitative method on the basis of facts and evidence given in musical and Vedic literature, the goal has been set. It was found that those who wish to attain Brahman or proceed on the path of liberation (moksha) practice the worship of anahata nada more than ahata nada and regard it as the nada that grants liberation, whereas those who desire the luxuries of the world and the fulfillment of various worldly wishes were found to practice only ahata nada, that is, the nada that gives pleasure. At the same time, even though there is said to be no practical relationship between anahata nada and practical music, the study has shown that ahata nada also plays a major role in stabilizing an extremely restless mind in the worshipful Brahman. It is expected that for those who wish to study the subject of nadanusandhana, the results of this study will not only increase knowledge but also pave a definite, scripture-validated path.

It was found that people who want to attain Brahman or head down the path of liberation (moksha) practise worshipping anahata nada more than ahata nada and reckon it’s the nada that grants liberation, while those who want the luxuries of the world and to fulfil all sorts of worldly wishes were found to practise only ahata nada, that is, the nada that gives pleasure. It’s hoped that for anyone keen to study nadanusandhana, the results of this study will not only boost their knowledge but also open up a clear, scripture-backed path.
